description: This file contains C source code for converting object files between different hash algorithms within a git repository. It includes functions for converting commits, trees, tags, and generic objects, managing object IDs, and decoding tree entries. It interacts with other parts of the git codebase like repository management, object reading, and hash functions.

methods.name: int repo_oid_to_algop(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Converts an object ID from its current hash algorithm to a target algorithm within a repository context, possibly reloading the object map if needed.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry_raw(struct object_id * oid,const char ** path,size_t * len,const struct git_hash_algo * algo,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Decodes a raw tree entry, extracting the object ID and path from a buffer according to the specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: int convert_tree_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tree object buffer from one hash algorithm to another, decoding each entry and mapping object IDs.

methods.name: int convert_tag_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tag object buffer from one hash algorithm to another, handling signatures and object references.

methods.name: int convert_commit_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a commit object buffer from one hash algorithm to another, remapping tree, parent, and mergetag references, and updating commit metadata.

methods.name: int convert_object_file(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * outbuf,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const void * buf,size_t len,enum object_type type,int gentle)
methods.description: Main function that converts an object file (commit, tree, tag) from one hash algorithm to another, calling specific conversion functions based on object type.
